scripts.build:remotes: npm run build -w apps/mf-auth -w apps/mf-home -w apps/mf-emergency -w apps/mf-hospital -w apps/mf-ambulatorio -w apps/mf-auditoria -w apps/mf-header -w apps/mf-sidebar -w apps/mf-footer -w apps/mf-triage -w apps/mf-clinical-record
scripts.build:remotes:dev: npm run build -w apps/mf-auth -w apps/mf-home -w apps/mf-emergency -w apps/mf-hospital -w apps/mf-ambulatorio -w apps/mf-auditoria -w apps/mf-header -w apps/mf-sidebar -w apps/mf-footer -w apps/mf-triage -w apps/mf-clinical-record -- --mode development
scripts.preview:remotes: concurrently -n auth,home,emergency,hospital,ambulatorio,auditoria,header,sidebar,footer,triage,clinical-record -c magenta,green,red,blue,yellow,white,gray,gray,gray,gray "npm --workspace apps/mf-auth run preview" "npm --workspace apps/mf-home run preview" "npm --workspace apps/mf-emergency run preview" "npm --workspace apps/mf-hospital run preview" "npm --workspace apps/mf-ambulatorio run preview" "npm --workspace apps/mf-auditoria run preview" "npm --workspace apps/mf-header run preview" "npm --workspace apps/mf-sidebar run preview" "npm --workspace apps/mf-footer run preview" "npm --workspace apps/mf-triage run preview" "npm --workspace apps/mf-clinical-record run preview"
scripts.clean: rimraf apps/mf-auth/dist apps/mf-home/dist apps/mf-shell/dist apps/mf-emergency/dist apps/mf-hospital/dist apps/mf-ambulatorio/dist apps/mf-auditoria/dist apps/mf-header/dist apps/mf-sidebar/dist apps/mf-footer/dist apps/mf-triage/dist apps/mf-clinical-record/dist
scripts.start: npm run clean && npm run build:shell && npm run build:remotes:dev && concurrently -n shell,remotes -c bgGreen,bgBlue "npm run preview:shell" "wait-on http://localhost:10500 && npm run preview:remotes"
scripts.build: npm run build:shell && npm run build:remotes
